purpose: Untouched external preflight for the Tampa quantitative early-warning hypothesis using MarineGEO Global Seagrass Habitat Monitoring.

source.dataset: MarineGEO Global Seagrass Habitat Monitoring Data
source.publisher: United States Geological Survey / Smithsonian MarineGEO network
source.protocol: three fixed 50-m transects per site, intended to be permanent and usually sampled annually; seagrass cover measured every 4 m along transects

frozen_hypothesis: Among annual sampling units with recorded seagrass presence, lower source-year quantitative cover predicts greater next-year recorded-state instability beyond space/time/effort baseline.
no_rescue: Do not open occurrence or measurement payloads when the public temporal scope already fails the frozen minimum.
Do not lower the minimum scored target-year requirement.
Do not reinterpret multiple transects within a single year as temporal replication.
